summary: Starwood Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to declare its monthly distributions for May 2026 across four classes of common stock. Gross per-share distributions are $0.0770, with net distributions ranging from $0.0627 (Class S) to $0.0770 (Class I) after stockholder servicing fees. The distributions are payable on June 3, 2026, in cash or reinvested shares. There is no M&A, activist, strategic review, tender, restructuring, or special-situation event. This is a routine operational disclosure with no implications for a special-situations category.
